verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no research run whose depth, effort, or scope can be set before or adjusted during execution. What it does show are adjacent controls: choosing which sources chat answers draw from, picking a conversational style, and choosing an Audio Overview format such as Deep Dive or Brief. These govern answer grounding and artifact formatting rather than a research process, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can steer the depth, effort, and scope of a research run before or while it executes
